newsitem.title: JORDAN: Hamas leader deported by U.S. arrives in Jordan.
newsitem.headline: Hamas leader deported by U.S. arrives in Jordan.

text.p: The political leader of the Islamic Resistance Movement Hamas, Musa Abu Marzook, arrived in Jordan on Monday after being deported by the United States, a spokesman of the militant movement said.
"Dr Abu Marzook arrived in Amman from the United States," Mohammed Nazal, Hamas representative in Jordan, said.
Nazal said Abu Marzook, former Hamas politburo chief released from a New York jail, arrived on a special U.S. military plane which landed in Amman military airport.
Jordanian authorities, who last week said King Hussein would allow Abu Marzook to return "without any obligations" other than abiding by Jordanian law, were notified of his arrival, Nazal said.

Abu Marzook, accused by Israel of responsibility for a wave of attacks in which scores of Israelis died, was arrested in New York a few weeks after his expulsion from Jordan in 1995. He was jailed while Israel sought his extradition but never charged.

"Dr Abu Marzook is in good health and his spirits are high but has arrived exhausted after a long journey in which he has flown straight after release from prison," Nazal told Reuters from Abu Marzook's Amman residence.

Jordan's Foreign Minister Fayez al-Tarawneh said on Sunday Jordan, which expelled Abu Marzook two years ago under pressure from Washington, Israel and the Palestinians, would not let him back in without an explicit U.S. request.

Israeli security officials said in February that Israel, fearing a wave of violence if he was taken to an Israeli prison, would drop its demand for Abu Marzook's extradition in return for a pledge to shun violence.
Amman-based Hamas officials deny their leader was returning under certain conditions and stress Abu Marzook would resume playing a leading political role in the organisation once he settles in Amman.
Abu Marzook has maintained throughout his detention that he was only involved in political activities while in Amman.
